description: This file defines the 'Task' controller class within the OpenCart admin startup namespace. It includes methods to register a shutdown function and start tasks via CLI or shell commands, managing task processing in the admin panel.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Controller class to handle task scheduling and execution in the OpenCart admin startup module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Registers a shutdown function to invoke the start method if the script is not run from CLI.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts tasks from the task queue if none are currently processing, executing via CLI or shell depending on OS.
